summary: Add read-only RPC sampling for public explorer integration planning
details: Validate the selected network bundle and sample standard EVM RPC methods, optional historical balances and an existing transaction receipt at a checked chain head.
Keep archive and tracing gaps visible without treating basic samples as completed explorer indexing, wallet integration or public endpoint qualification.
Refuse transaction submission methods, omit RPC URLs from reports, and require explicit opt-in for one bounded transaction trace.
Document the ordered explorer/RPC, faucet and operator console rollout, including shared-host resource budgeting and USDB-specific block and reward semantics.
operator_actions: Run check_explorer_rpc.py from the node kit with the installed bundle and an existing transaction hash before preparing an explorer deployment. Inspect optional failures even when basic_rpc_passed is true.
